options.name: Core tip becomes the new integration base
options.work: Point the integration boundary at 6f1b7d0b plus the existing parity commit 53150b91, then merge client/relayer-domain-beta on top. Carry nothing else: the only integration-only delta is two lines that the client branch already has.
options.size: smallest. Zero conflict resolution on the seven files, zero reimplementation, one branch pointer decision plus one client merge whose non-client surface is four files: apps/web/app/components/wire/wire-month-calendar.tsx and its test, packages/wire/src/wire-button.tsx, scripts/design/token-audit.mjs.
options.risk: low. Retires the CCC-286 duplicate rather than merging it, so the CCC-286 Linear completion must be read as satisfied by core a6b2fc47. Existing verified parity evidence stays valid because 53150b91 was generated on this exact lineage.
evidence: client diff 46e32f8a..0cefde1e touches only four non-client files

options.name: Keep the integration branch and merge core into it
options.work: Resolve the seven conflicting files by hand, which in practice means taking the core side for all of them, then regenerate migrations/parity.yaml again because integration's 19-checkpoint manifest and its checkpoint registry both lose.
options.size: largest. Twelve conflict blocks plus two add/add files, a full manifest regeneration, and a re-run of the parity command to prove the merged result.
options.risk: high. Hand resolution of gateway.ts with six blocks can silently drop CCC-289, CCC-299 or CCC-301 lines, and the outcome is byte-equivalent to option A because core is the superset in all seven files.

options.name: Replay equivalent changes from origin/main
options.work: Start from origin/main and re-land the same functional changes.
options.size: largest by far and unnecessary. The integration branch is already 16 commits ahead of origin/main with behind 0, and core carries twelve commits across five tickets.
options.risk: highest. Loses the verified proofs for CCC-286, CCC-289, CCC-291 and CCC-299 and reopens every acceptance artifact already collected.

A: Declare core a6b2fc47 as the canonical CCC-286 delivery so integration 8feb4c62 and 7c7b632d retire without a Linear reopen.
Confirm migrations/parity.yaml canonical home is the parity lane commit 53150b91, and that the integration branch's 19-checkpoint manifest is abandoned rather than merged.
Confirm the checkpoint registry canonical list is core's 25 rows in apps/api/test/support/migration-parity.ts.
Decide who carries the two-line scripts/design/token-audit.mjs delta: the client merge or a direct two-line commit.
B: Same four decisions as option A, plus a per-file resolution ruling for manual-record.ts, manual-record.contract.test.ts, support-case-report.contract.test.ts and gateway.ts, each of which is only defensible as take-core.
Approve a second parity regeneration and re-run after the merge.
C: Approve discarding the accepted proofs for CCC-286, CCC-289, CCC-291 and CCC-299 and re-verifying all of them.
